thread_title: S. purp. purp. Caroline Co, VA (Giants!)
breadcrumb: S. purp. purp. Caroline Co, VA (Giants!)

posts.body_html:
some updated pics of this clone. usually, it's only once in a lifetime that we get a chance to acquire new genetics from the same site and but about a year ago I was able to get more! There's no knowing if the new accession is giant but the first time around I suspected the plants all came from one single individual. Hopefully this time around there will be at least a little bit of diversity, we will see in a few years once the plants grow up and I have something to show.

In the meantime, this old clone looks like it's in the wild, but it's actually growing in the collection where some sphagnum moss has overtaken the tray. pics taken 7/24/25








The psittacinas in the background...dead giveaway that this is in cultivation, aint no psitts in VA growing in the wild!
